meta.name: Quick Find
meta.notes: Primary fills the 62vh search band, the CTA block, active filters and the palette selection bar; product pads are a 9% primary tint with multiply-blended packshots; on-primary drives all text on the band; accent is left as a quiet default.

issues: Catalog: `.cwrap{padding:0 0 …}` wiped the .wrap side padding, so filter chips, product rows and add buttons ran flush against both viewport edges (the 'Alle' chip touched x=0)
Home list heading doubled up for brands without a catalog title: 'Ons assortiment assortiment'
Inline catalog search reordered by score, but the ranking stayed invisible. Nothing showed why a row moved to the top, so the signature interaction felt like a plain filter
Mobile nav was cut off mid-word ('Rep…') with no sign that it scrolls
Gallery strip cropped its last tile at a hard edge on desktop, which looked like a layout bug rather than a scroller; all tiles were the same size, so the strip had no rhythm
Mobile stats stacked into three tall single-column blocks of thin numerals, which added a lot of empty scroll
Scores: creativity 7, typography 7, layout 6.5, polish 5.5 (catalog edge bug), brand robustness 7.5, mobile 6, generic-ness 6.5
fixed: Catalog main now keeps .wrap's horizontal padding (only padding-bottom set), so the list and toolbar sit inside the grid again
Home list heading is now a muted 'Snel gevonden in' kicker above the bold catalog title (fallback 'Ons assortiment'), so no word repeats for any brand

Catalog inline engine writes each row's live fuzzy score as a small mono readout ('BESTE MATCH · 87 pt'), tinted from --c-primary mixed with text for contrast, in both list and grid views. The FLIP reordering now visibly follows the scorer
Mobile nav on both pages bleeds to the screen edges and fades out on the right, so it reads as a swipeable rail
Gallery became a staggered strip (alternating 1:1 / 4:5 / 5:4 tiles) that bleeds off the right edge behind a fade mask, so the cut-off tile reads as intentional
Mobile stats now sit in a 2-column grid with hairline dividers and tighter numerals; an odd last stat spans the full width
